zoe: opened PR 5820 - 'KV-cache prefetch + batching examples + dashboard cost widget' 
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5820
zoe: needs quick sanity check for PHP and C# SDK snippets and to sweep for any stale anchors in the observability pages. aiming to merge before tomorrow's docs cut.
arjun: taking PHP + widget JSON.
maya: i'll handle C# and run the preview.
zoe: PHP snippet in the PR is:
```php
<?php
require 'vendor/autoload.php';
$client = new \Redwood\Client(getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'));
$resp = $client->kv->prefetch(['prefix' => 'sess:', 'limit' => 30]);
print_r(array_slice($resp['keys'], 0, 5));
```
arjun: quick nit: our PHP SDK uses method names without the ->kv->prefetch chain in the helper samples; prefer $client->prefetchKV(['prefix' => ...]) to match other docs. i'll push that tweak. also the snippet should show try/catch for network errors.
maya: C# snippet pasted below; testing now:
```csharp
using Redwood;
var client = new RedwoodClient(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDWOOD_KEY"));
var entries = await client.Kv.PrefetchAsync("sess:", 30);
Console.WriteLine(entries.Count);
```
maya: found mismatch: our C# SDK uses PrefetchKVAsync(client, prefix, limit) static helper in samples. will update to idiomatic usage and add CancellationToken example.
link-bot: linkcheck: broken anchor -> /docs/console/observability#kv-prefetch-example-old -> 404
zoe: thanks link-bot. root anchor in the migration guides got renamed last month. should be #kv-prefetch-example. i'll update the three links in the PR.
arjun: updated PHP snippet and added try/catch. pushed.

arjun: widget JSON used field "usd_cost" but our widget expects "cost_us". fixing now.

zoe: thanks. also flag: small paragraph about "latency shading" has ambiguous phrasing for SLO owners. can we expand with a 1-line prescriptive action?
maya: suggested wording: "SLO owners: prefer gradual batch size increases during canary to observe latency impact; revert if 95th exceeds SLO by >10% for 5m." feel free to reword.
\oarjun: small type: i saw an inline backtick in the paragraph that causes rendering weirdness; removed it in my push.
